crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast horizontal white band at the base of the neck, situated below two distinct, symmetrically placed white rectangular patches on the posterior crown/nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, high-contrast linear boundary defined by a horizontal white band separating the dark plumage of the upper neck from the dark mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific white spot pattern on the dorsal head/neck consisting of two isolated white squares positioned vertically above a wider white cervical bar.
